Name: DGR-012 - ANCILE
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: The ANCILE is primarily a defense-oriented mass-produced DGR, of which only 12 were created. They are able to create convincing illusions of themselves that confuse enemies into thinking that a squad of enemies. They were created primarily to be distractions in combat, as well as to form as shock troops meant to engage in melee combat.

traits.name: Protection of Twelve
traits.description:
The DGR makes use of eleven illusions of itself that move adjacent to it, confusing attackers. Any creature (except those that can see through illusions or doesn’t rely on sight) that attacks the DGR must roll 1d12 each time they hit it. On a result of 11 or lower, the attack automatically misses and a copy is hit instead, and a result of 12 hits the original - until this trait resets, any time that result is rolled again it is rerolled until a 12 or a so-far unrolled result is achieved. Alternatively, each time the remaining number of unrolled results is a 10, 8, 6 or 4 you may roll a d10, d8, d6 or d4 respectively, treating the highest result on each die as hitting the original.

Each time the DGR completes a Long Rest it resets this trait.

Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**DGR-012 - ANCILE**
*Huge construct (DGR), unaligned [footprint 3]*
**Armor Class** 17 (natural armor) **Threshold** 10
**Hit Points** 173 (15d12 + 75)
**Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (hover), 0-G acceleration 180 ft.
**Quality Traits** Immutable, magical, unique
**STR** 20 (+5) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 20 (+5) | **INT** 15 (+2) | **WIS** 17 (+3) | **CHA** 10 (+0)
**Saving Throws** Con +10, Wis +7
**Skills** Perception +8
**Resistances** B/S/P (magical)
**Immunities** necrotic, poison
**Condition Immunities** blinded, deafened, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, unconscious
**Senses** blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 18
**Languages** understands all, but doesn’t speak
**Challenge Rating** 13 (10,000 XP) **Prof Bonus** +5

***Protection of Twelve.*** The DGR makes use of eleven illusions of itself that move adjacent to it, confusing attackers. Any creature (except those that can see through illusions or doesn’t rely on sight) that attacks the DGR must roll 1d12 each time they hit it. On a result of 11 or lower, the attack automatically misses and a copy is hit instead, and a result of 12 hits the original - until this trait resets, any time that result is rolled again it is rerolled until a 12 or a so-far unrolled result is achieved. Alternatively, each time the remaining number of unrolled results is a 10, 8, 6 or 4 you may roll a d10, d8, d6 or d4 respectively, treating the highest result on each die as hitting the original.

Each time the DGR completes a Long Rest it resets this trait.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The DGR makes two melee weapon attacks.

***Enhanced Slam.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

***Arm Cannon.*** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 100/300 feet, one target. *Hit:* 31 (5d10 + 3) radiant damage.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Elimination Cover.*** The DGR can sacrifice one of the unrolled results from its Protection of Twelve feature to have that illusion run interference around it, causing all attacks made against the DGR to have disadvantage until the start of its next turn. The lowest remaining die result is the one eliminated from Protection of the Twelve.

**REACTIONS**
***Shield Reactor (3/Day).*** When the DGR is hit with a weapon attack it generates a spherical shield of energy, which grants it a +5 bonus to its armor class (possibly changing the attack’s result) and resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.
